name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – After § 17 – Am 11
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 17a. Calls on the Ukrainian authorities to unequivocally condemn and take action on the prohibition of banderite symbols and the prohibition of the promotion of the ideology of the Bandera faction of the Organization of Ukrainian Nationalists – (OUN-B) and the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA), which were responsible for the genocide in Volhynia and neighbouring regions between 1943 and 1945; calls on the Member States to introduce a ban on the dissemination of banderite ideology and symbols within their territories;
